test_name: Search for a Product Using the Search Bar
description: This scenario tests the functionality of the search bar to locate specific products.
steps: Locate the search bar in the header.
Click on the search bar to activate it.
Type the product name 'Dark Brown Jeans' into the search bar.
Press Enter to initiate the search.
Verify the search results page loads with relevant products matching the query.
Locate the product 'Dark Brown Jeans' in the search results.
Click on the product link to view its detailed page.
expected_results: The search results page should display products matching the query.
The 'Dark Brown Jeans' product should be clickable and lead to its detailed page.
edge_cases: No results are found for the search query.
The search query contains typos or special characters.
The search bar is not responsive to user input.
User initiates a search without typing anything.
The search results page takes too long to load.
data_requirements: Product catalog data for search indexing.
Expected search results for 'Dark Brown Jeans'.
Search results page layout and content.
dependencies: The search functionality must be implemented and working.
The product 'Dark Brown Jeans' must exist in the catalog.
The search results page must be functional.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the search results page.
accessibility_requirements: Search bar should be accessible via keyboard navigation.
Screen readers should announce the purpose of the search bar.
Search results should be navigable using keyboard shortcuts.
